title: The AI Democratization Paradox: Evidence from Decentralized Knowledge Communities
near_miss_reason: Matrix completion counterfactual estimator (fect, Athey et al. 2021; not an admitted estimator) is the only estimator of the staggered design reported in the main text (Figures 7, 8, 11); the other main-text specifications are a single-cohort time-shift design with language-specific linear trends (unit trends; ATT 79.1) and a blocked DiD with treated-by-decile subgroup-by-treatment interactions (Figure 12). The qualifying static TWFE (Table A.2: 61.4, SE 14.9), Sun-Abraham (Figure A.1) and Callaway-Sant'Anna (Figure A.2) estimates appear only in the web appendix, and the main text cites them without numbers (checked against the published text, Nov 4). Staggered binary design: Google Translate availability at language-specific months (6 cohorts 2019-01 to 2020-08, 42 never-treated languages), language and month FE, no controls, public data.
eligible_reason: The underlying design qualifies (binary absorbing Google Translate availability, 6 adoption cohorts 2019-01..2020-08, 42 never-treated languages, language and month FE, no controls), and the package contains fully qualifying static TWFE, Sun-Abraham and Callaway-Sant'Anna estimates with public data. But none of these is reported in the MAIN TEXT: the main text reports only (i) matrix-completion counterfactual imputation (fect method='mc'; Figures 7, 8, 11), (ii) a time-shift design with language-specific trends and a single cohort (ATT 79.1), and (iii) a single-cohort 'blocked' DiD with treated-by-decile interactions (Figure 12). The TWFE (Table A.2, 61.4 (14.9)), Sun-Abraham (Figure A.1), CSA (Figure A.2) and displacement TWFE results appear only in the web appendix, and the main-text robustness paragraph cites them without numbers. Under the PROTOCOL Section 2 main-text rule the paper is NOT eligible as published; recorded as an override candidate because the appendix TWFE/CSA pair is exactly Hull's comparison and is trivially replicable.
design_notes: Unit: Wikipedia target language (132). Time: month, 2017-01..2020-12 (48). Outcome n = monthly published Content-Translation articles into the language. treated = 1[year_month >= enable_date], absorbing. Cohorts: 2019-01-01 (78), 2019-06-01 (1), 2019-10-01 (1), 2020-04-01 (5), 2020-06-01 (2), 2020-08-01 (3); 42 never treated (enable_date 2049-01-01). Primary estimator fect matrix completion with two-way FE; TWFE, SA and CSA (never-treated controls) run on the same panel as appendix robustness. Secondary language-month panel (language-month-panel.csv, 271 languages 2015-07..2023-12) used for displacement DiD on non-translated article counts and views, restricted to 2017-2020 and the 122 matched languages (N 5,856). Heterogeneity models interact treated with resource deciles. Package also contains main.tex, web_appendix.tex and main.pdf.

screener_notes: Treatment column 'treated' verified against enable_date (exact agreement, no switch-off). Stacked DiD is claimed in the text but no code exists in the package. Check the published PDF (main.pdf in package) in case Table A.2 moved into the main text in production.
